subject: GCP private offer: retroactive credit reconciliation & partner split
messages:
From: Maria Ruiz <maria.ruiz@cloudwave.com>
To: michael.grant@redwood.ai
Cc: channel-ops@cloudwave.com; t.lee@cloudwave.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP private offer: need reconciliation for retro credits + partner split

Hi Michael,

Thanks for taking this — CloudWave's Channel Ops team is reviewing the private offer GCP committed spend that went live in July. We noticed a couple of items we need your help with so we can complete our internal finance reconciliation:

- A retroactive credit line applied in August (labelled "usage correction") that we don't see reflected in the Marketplace PO amount.
- Confirmation of the partner split applied to the private offer (we expected a 20% channel margin; the invoice line items look like 12% in a couple of months).

Can you share a workback that ties the private-offer list price, any retro credits, and the final vendor payout to CloudWave? Ideally a spreadsheet we can align on with GCP billing IDs. We also need to understand if Redwood applied any late adjustments or marketplace commission overrides.

Attached: GCP billing export (redacted) and our reconciliation template.

We'd like to resolve this by end of week so our accounting team can close the month. If useful, please loop in whoever owns Marketplace/private-offer engineering.

Cheers,
Maria Ruiz
Head of Channel Finance | CloudWave Solutions

Attachments: cloudwave_gcp_redacted.csv (csv), reconciliation_template.xlsx (xlsx)
From: michael.grant@redwood.ai
To: Maria Ruiz <maria.ruiz@cloudwave.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP private offer: need reconciliation for retro credits + partner split

Maria — thanks for the clear note and the templates. We've pulled the ledger for the PO and started a line-item mapping to your template. High level updates:

- The "usage correction" credit was processed by our billing engine on 2026-08-24; it corrected an over-ingestion adjustment tied to token-metering differences. That credit reduced the customer-facing invoice but did not flow through as a separate marketplace rebate in the offer calculation; rather it reduced the gross billable base that the partner split is applied against.

- There was an interim commission override for Sept '26 tied to a short-term incentive we offered in July for early-commit customers. That override applied to a narrow set of SKUs and was manually applied by the marketplace operations team. I'll include the list.

I'll attach a workback spreadsheet with three tabs: 1) Gross list price per invoice (by invoice id), 2) Credits & adjustments (including the August usage correction), 3) Partner payout waterfall (how 20% nominal margin maps to actual $ paid after credits/overrides).

Vanessa / Karthik — flag if you want me to modify the waterfall formatting before I send to CloudWave. Vanessa: can you confirm whether we documented that promotional override in the Marketplace change log?

I will send the workbook and a short summary doc in the next message.

Best,
Michael Grant
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments: partner-margin-workback.xlsx (xlsx)
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Maria Ruiz <maria.ruiz@cloudwave.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP private offer: need reconciliation for retro credits + partner split

Thanks Michael — quick confirmation from ops: the promotional override was recorded in the marketplace change log (entry 2026-07-31-PROMO-42). It applied to customers who signed before 2026-08-15 and was scoped to the 'premium-llm' SKU only. The override reduced the platform take by 8% on those SKUs for the promo window, which explains the lower-than-expected partner margin in Sept for two invoice lines.

Maria — attaching the Redwood ops excerpt and a one-page explanation of how we apply credits vs. rebates. The short version: credits reduce the gross base before commission splits; rebates (rare) are paid out after partner splits.

Let us know if you'd like us to propose a retroactive reimbursement that treats the August credit as a post-split rebate (that would increase CloudWave's payout but requires sign-off and budget approval).

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partner Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: gcp_private_offer_summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Maria Ruiz <maria.ruiz@cloudwave.com>

Thanks Vanessa and Michael — that helps a lot. Two quick asks from our CFO:

1) Can Redwood produce a one-line statement that shows: gross list charges (by invoice), credits applied (by date), and final partner payout per invoice id? We need this stamped for our audit.

2) If Redwood is willing to treat the August "usage correction" as a post-split rebate, what's the budget impact and what approvals would be required? CloudWave is requesting a retro payout for the six affected invoice lines; rough estimate based on our numbers would be ~USD 27k additional payout.

If it's easier, we can formalize as an amendment to the private offer and handle payment via a credit memo. Could you also share any DocuSign or marketplace amendment link we should expect?

Appreciate it — we're targeting to finalize before Friday close.

— Maria

Maria — quick summary and next steps:

1) Deliverables (attached): partner-margin-workback.xlsx (workback with invoice ids + waterfall) and draft-mop-agreement.docx (amendment language to treat the August usage correction as a post-split rebate for the six invoice lines). The workbook includes the one-line statement your CFO requested in tab 'AuditStatement'.

2) Budget impact: assigning the August credit as a post-split rebate increases partner payout by $27,460. We can cover this from our marketplace reconciliation reserve, but the finance team requires an approval chain: (a) VP Finance sign-off, (b) Head of Partnerships sign-off (that's me), and (c) a DocuSign amendment to the private offer to record the rebate.

3) Timeline: if CloudWave signs the amendment by EOD Fri 2026-11-06 we can issue the credit memo dated 2026-11-10 and have the partner payout reflected in the Nov 15 settlement run.

Action items:
- Maria: confirm you want Redwood to treat the August credit as a post-split rebate (reply with ACK).
- CloudWave finance: sign the attached amendment (DocuSign link to follow once we have ACK).
- Karthik: please note for marketplace ledger; we'll need to tag the invoice lines for settlement.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20m call this afternoon if helpful.

Best,
Michael
